title: console(detail): a field group's visibleWhen gates the form but not the record detail page — the section renders whatever the predicate says
body:
QA-source: objectstack-ai/objectstack#21784 · records-forms.field-group-visible-when · acceptance[3]

A clause of `records-forms.field-group-visible-when` fails in the ObjectStack 17.7 pre-release checklist run objectstack-ai/objectstack#21784 (framework subject `316be321e`, console pin `2e818d0b51ec`). An independent verifier (VF2, RUNNER rule 7) confirmed it: P2. It predates the 17.6.0 console pin `31971ff1e`; no open duplicate was found. Owner: objectui.

## Reproduction

1. Admin creates a writable package and `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/qa_group_gate4?package={pkg}` with a `kind` select (basic / pro), two pro fields, and `fieldGroups:[{key:'pro', label:'Pro details', fields:[…], visibleWhen:{dialect:'cel', source:"record.kind == 'pro'"}}]` (the bare-string form behaves the same).
2. Create one row with `kind:'basic'` and one with `kind:'pro'`.
3. Edit form: the "Pro details" section is absent at basic, appears live on switching to pro, and disappears on switching back (holds).
4. Open `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/qa_group_gate4/record/{basic id}`. Expected: no "Pro details" section. Actual: the section renders, header included, for both rows. Seen twice on fresh launches.

## Mechanism

objectui `plugin-detail` `buildDefaultPageSchema.ts:717-729` — the synthesized detail page does not apply the group predicate. The form (`plugin-form/src/fieldGroups.ts`) carries and evaluates it live at the pin (the clause was authored as an expected-fail; its form half is now fixed). Predates 17.6.0.

## Done when

The detail page evaluates `visibleWhen` per group exactly as the form does.
